verdict.rationale: The axis plausibly applies, because the GPU ships with a companion UI (the NVIDIA app, used to manage DLSS overrides and settings) and also exposes developer APIs such as CUDA. However, nothing in the evidence shows that NVIDIA app or UI functions can be reached programmatically. The CUDA, cuTile and Nsight material covers compute programming and profiling, not UI parity, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.
